subject: genetics
question: **Type:** concept Gregor Mendel presented his pea experiments to the Brno Natural History Society and later published the full paper. In which years did he present and then publish this work?
explanation: Mendel presented his pea experiments to the Brno Natural History Society in 1865 and published the paper in 1866. B swaps the two years. C substitutes 1859, the year of Darwin's On the Origin of Species. D gives 1900 and 1901, when de Vries, Correns, and Tschermak independently rediscovered Mendel's laws after the paper had gone largely unnoticed.
